en_US.in_game_wiki: Dossier header - Tau Ceti ledger mirror. The archive did not answer in time to change the flooded room, the dead route, or the contract on your back. It proves one narrower fact: this packet crossed a claimant-independent relay with witness hashes intact. Treat every blank line as protected custody, not mercy. Redaction keeps coordinates, names, and receiver outcomes from becoming bait.
en_US.external_site:
Redaction notice. This archive page contains evidence released through the Tau Ceti public ledger after relay custody left the claimant's control. Visible fragments are limited to the packet notary seal, witness hash band, custody timestamps, and the minimum context needed to read the record. Names, precise routes, body references, receiver outcomes, and pressure-site coordinates remain masked where exposure could turn evidence into bounty fraud, retaliation, market pressure, or fresh cleanup work.

The redaction does not clear Deep Reach, condemn Deep Reach, or tell the reader what finally happened. It means the notary proof can show that a packet existed before claimant review and that a claimant-independent relay carried enough witness hashes to stop clean erasure. The archive is late by design. It is an evidence shelf, not a recovery channel and not a verdict.
en_US.field_note:
Marauder correction: if this header reaches you early, somebody sold you a lie. Public archive text belongs after the payload leaves the claimant's grip. It cannot tow you home. It cannot put cuffs on anyone. It can make a clean erasure expensive, and that is all it promises.

## Future Integration Notes

Proposed LocIDs:

- LORE_EVIDENCE_PUBLIC_ARCHIVE_REDACTION_HEADER_BRIDGE_TITLE
- LORE_EVIDENCE_PUBLIC_ARCHIVE_REDACTION_HEADER_BRIDGE_EXTERNAL_ARCHIVE_BODY
- LORE_EVIDENCE_PUBLIC_ARCHIVE_REDACTION_HEADER_BRIDGE_INGAME_DOSSIER_BODY
- LORE_EVIDENCE_PUBLIC_ARCHIVE_REDACTION_HEADER_BRIDGE_REDACTION_FRAGMENT
- LORE_EVIDENCE_PUBLIC_ARCHIVE_REDACTION_HEADER_BRIDGE_MARAUDER_ANNOTATION

External_site/wiki placement: spoiler-gated archive page header above evidence fragments that have notary and witness hash display. The page may show custody logic and redaction policy. It must not expose final payload receiver consequences outside its spoiler lane.

In-game dossier placement: late/post-ending evidence dossier header when public ledger or archive-mirror material is visible. The dossier version should be shorter, harsher, and tied to the player's route cost. It must not unlock in the first-20 route.

Authoring bridge note: this file is markdown source only. Future string-pool extraction should use the Loc namespace above and keep text in the Narrative layer. The runtime consumer must use baked IDs/hashes, not live markdown parsing.

Localization note: non-English rows below are draft coverage only. RTL/CJK/font/layout and native-language review remain separate proof work.

## GlobalQualityWeight Presentation Density

Low/Compact: show title, one-sentence redaction purpose, packet notary seal, witness hash band, and a short misuse warning. Keep the dossier clear and short; no optional archive commentary. Truth, IDs, and spoiler lock remain unchanged.

Middle: show the full redaction header fragment plus one dossier paragraph. Add custody delay and claimant-independent relay context. Do not add new canon facts.

High: add the external archive / wiki body, stronger custody explanation, and the Marauder annotation. Use richer presentation around the same text: seal texture, archive noise, hash grouping, and evidence crosslink labels.

Ultra: allow extended archive framing, secondary misuse notes, and denser dossier crosslinks after the spoiler gate. Ultra adds context density only; it does not change Article ID, LocIDs, canon facts, receiver truth, ending eligibility, or public claim state.

en_US.title: In-Game Evidence Queue Routing Bridge
en_US.scanner:
Queue item flagged: custody route incomplete.

Recovered packet carries a partial witness hash and a damaged relay stamp. Next useful action is not collection. Preserve the seal, compare the hash against another physical source, and keep the item out of Black Keel payout sorting until the notary chain is less exposed.

Decision value: a matched witness hash can move the item from salvage value to evidence. A broken chain lets Keelmark Mutual price it as material.
en_US.terminal:
RETURN ACTION QUEUE / LOCAL CACHE

Priority is assigned by control risk, not by discovery time.

1. Custody proof: confirm packet seal and source object before duplicate upload.
2. Notary hash: route through Luyten Packet Ladder when relay geometry opens; do not let claimant-side compression rewrite the witness block.
3. Quarantine hold: check whether the hold protects a living hazard, a legal delay, or a payload bargain.
4. Payout claim: identify whether Keelmark converts the record into mass, sample value, or unresolved worker load.
5. Partial-return debrief: keep the record attached to the route that produced it. A return note without evidence state is only a lien extension.

No item in this queue authorizes extraction by itself. Receiver, window, and evidence custody remain unresolved until the next route proof exists.
en_US.audio: Evidence queue update: the next record changes custody, payout, quarantine, public ledger exposure, or return leverage. No entry promises extraction.
en_US.in_game_wiki:
Evidence does not become useful because the player has found it. It becomes useful when the route can prove where it came from, who handled it, what changed, and who benefits if it disappears.

The queue ranks records by immediate decision pressure. Custody proof protects origin. Notary hashes protect the witness chain from claimant edits. Quarantine holds explain why a route or body was delayed. Payout claims show when Keelmark Mutual is converting people, samples, or silence into recoverable mass. Partial-return debriefs keep a failed or compromised exit from becoming a clean ending in the dossier.

The order can change when new physical evidence contradicts a corporate line. That is the point. A useful queue tells the player why the next record matters and what is still unknown.

Do not sort this like a library.

If the next card says "payout," ask what got priced. If it says "quarantine," ask who waited outside the door. If it says "notary," keep the original seal wet and ugly. Clean copies are how Deep Reach wins arguments it cannot win in the room.

Partial return is not freedom. It is a debrief with a debt hook unless the evidence rides out with its teeth still in it.

en_US.scanner: Packet strip recovered. Custody seal is external to the claimant desk. LocID hash marks match one narrative namespace, spoiler byte is present, and the string-pool row is only a source stub. Treat as eligible evidence, not as baked data.
en_US.terminal:
PACKET NOTARY INTERFACE / AEGIR RELAY CUSTODY

Receipt: DATA_MONOLITH_ADMISSION_RECEIPT_BRIDGE

Claimant desk: Deep Reach Recovery Compliance, disputed.

Off-claimant witness: Luyten Packet Ladder notary mesh, delayed return.

LocID hash: present.

Spoiler byte: present.

String-pool row: reserved in source form only.

Relation record: source link between receipt, packet, claimant, and witness hash.

Decision: packet may enter offline static-data admission review. No runtime binary state, no DataMonolith payload state, and no h8bin artifact state are certified by this receipt.
en_US.audio: Packet strip recovered. Custody proof may enter offline static-data admission review; no runtime binary or h8bin artifact is certified.
en_US.in_game_wiki:
The receipt is a narrow kind of proof. It says a packet can be considered for offline admission because its custody marks do not rely on the claimant alone. The useful parts are small: stable LocID hashes, a spoiler byte, a source string-pool row, a relation record, and a witness path that can survive Deep Reach cleanup.

It does not mean the game systems have consumed it. It does not mean a Data Monolith payload exists. It means the packet is no longer only somebody's story.

Deep Reach likes the word "admitted." They put it on paper before anything heavy has moved. Read the teeth marks: LocID hash, spoiler byte, row stub, relation stub, witness hash. If the witness route is outside their desk, keep it. If the strip says binary, ask where the payload is. If they cannot show it, they are selling paper.

Hash route: LocID hashes remain derived from LocID strings, not localized text. The receipt language must never become gameplay authority by visible text parsing.

Spoiler byte: proposed value `0x02`, matching a mid-evidence custody surface. Final numeric assignment belongs to source table work.

String-pool row: narrative pool candidate only. This packet reserves no live row and creates no binary payload.

Relation record: proposed relation links `DATA_MONOLITH_ADMISSION_RECEIPT_BRIDGE` to packet custody, claimant, witness hash, and later static-data admission evidence. It must not imply h8bin output until the appropriate bake and boot artifacts exist.

Claimant-independent proof: the receipt is meaningful only when witness hash and packet custody survive outside Deep Reach claimant control.

en_US.scanner: Translation hold active. Treat claimant wording, witness language, and Marauder notes as separate source lanes until native review and layout proof exist.
en_US.terminal:
PACKET TRANSLATION HOLD

Source custody: mixed witness, claimant, and Marauder annotation.
Archive condition: translation draft retained for evidence access.
Known risk: claimant language may sanitize liability, worker intent, or custody pressure.
Display risk: RTL, CJK, expansion, font fallback, and caption length require review before final surface binding.
Instruction: preserve source ID, speaker, custody mark, and disputed wording. Do not clean the claimant sentence without a witness-language note.
en_US.audio: Translation hold: clean claimant wording can launder liability. Draft text stays marked until native review and layout proof exist.
en_US.in_game_wiki:
This entry contains translated draft evidence. Treat claimant wording as contested, especially where Deep Reach terms replace a worker's direct description. Marauder notes preserve the practical reading: who spoke, what object carried the line, what was missing, and what the translation may have softened.

Native review and layout proof are pending. Do not treat the translated phrasing as final voice or final caption fit.
en_US.external_site:
Some HECTON-8 archive captions carry translated draft text because the recovered source is not always English. A worker's spoken line, a claimant clause, and a Marauder correction do not fail in the same way when they cross languages.

Deep Reach records often sound cleaner after translation than the room they describe. This archive keeps those lines marked until native review and layout proof can check tone, direction, font coverage, caption length, and the legal meaning of claimant wording. The mark is not a downgrade of the witness. It is a warning against laundering evidence through smooth language.
en_US.field_note:
If the claimant sentence reads kinder than the hatch, keep the hatch. Workers say "door would not open." Deep Reach writes "release pending." A bad translation can make both sound like weather.

Do not polish witness language until it stops bleeding. Mark the draft, keep the source line, and let the archive caption say who still has to check it.
